appfunction.description: Starts a fitness workout or exercise tracking session in Iron (Tracker for Pebble). Use this function when the user asks to start running, walking, cycling, hiking, kayaking, or rowing in Iron (e.g., "アイアンでランニングを開始して", "Start a run in Iron", "ウォーキング計測をスタートして").

parameters.name: exercise_name
parameters.description: Optional exercise type such as RUNNING, WALKING, CYCLING, HIKING, KAYAKING, or ROWING (or Japanese equivalents like ランニング, ウォーキング, サイクリング, ハイキング).

response.description: Confirmation message indicating the workout has started.

appfunction.description: Pauses the currently active workout tracking session in Iron (Tracker for Pebble). Use this when the user asks to pause their run or workout (e.g., "アイアンのワークアウトを一時停止して", "ランニングをポーズして", "Pause workout in Iron").

response.description: Confirmation message indicating the workout has been paused.

appfunction.description: Resumes a paused workout tracking session in Iron (Tracker for Pebble). Use this when the user asks to resume or continue their run or workout (e.g., "アイアンのワークアウトを再開して", "ランニングを再開して", "Resume workout in Iron").

response.description: Confirmation message indicating the workout has been resumed.

appfunction.description: Stops and saves the current workout tracking session in Iron (Tracker for Pebble). Use this when the user asks to finish, stop, or end their workout (e.g., "アイアンのワークアウトを終了して", "ランニングを終了して保存して", "Stop workout in Iron").

response.description: Confirmation message indicating the workout has been stopped and saved.

appfunction.description: Retrieves current real-time workout statistics from Iron (Tracker for Pebble), including pace, distance, elapsed time, and heart rate. Use this when the user asks about their current pace, heart rate, distance, or time during a workout (e.g., "アイアンで今のペースと心拍数を教えて", "今何キロ走った？", "What are my workout stats in Iron?").

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Optional specific metric to query: PACE, HEART_RATE, DISTANCE, TIME, or ALL.

response.description: Spoken summary of current workout statistics (pace, distance, elapsed time, heart rate).
